My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
If your tracking shows delivered but you do not have the package, the following steps are recommended:
Check around the delivery area
Inspect all doors, side entrances, garage, mailbox area, and any designated safe-drop location.
Consult with neighbors or building management in case the package was left nearby.
Allow a little extra time
Carriers may occasionally mark a package as delivered shortly before it actually arrives.
Use your tracking link to review the delivery details
Examine any notes from the carrier regarding the package's location.
If the package still does not appear, contact customer service
The customer service team can assist with order and shipping issues.
For your reference, the site states that consumer orders are typically shipped within 2 days, and after shipment, delivery time depends on the destination and carrier. Regular orders are shipped by UPS Ground.
